exposure: Embryo storage time (<3 months, 3-12 months, >12 months, 1-3 years, 3-5 years, >5 years)
Storage time (<3 months, 3-12 months, >12 months, 1-3 years, 3-5 years, >5 years)
cohort: Women who underwent at least one frozen-thawed cycle with single embryo transfer between January 1st, 2016 and September 30th, 2019
finding: The duration of vitrification did not significantly affect the pregnancy outcomes within 5 years period, however, the clinical pregnancy rate and live birth rate both decreased significantly when the duration of vitrification exceeded 5 years.
